newsitem.title: USA: Chase names Moctar Fall a managing director.
newsitem.headline: Chase names Moctar Fall a managing director.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp said on Friday it has hired Moctar Fall as head of the capital markets desk in the emerging markets group.

As managing director, Fall will report directly to Jorge Jasson, head of Chase's emerging market group. He will be responsible for capital markets coverage of emerging market sovereigns, quasi-sovereigns, agencies and frequent issuers.
Most recently, Fall was head of Latin America capital markets group at Salomon Brothers. Fall had lead the team that managed the market's first global bond offering for the World Bank in 1989.
